notes:
Account snapshot: enterprise logistics SaaS; building customer-facing conversational assistants + large-scale reranking for route optimization. Evaluation focused on Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) and model-specific tuning.

Summary of requirements:
- Workloads: interactive chat for customer ops (P95 latency target 150-250ms for short prompts), large batch reranking jobs (throughput target 600 QPS for embedding/rerank pipelines), nightly bulk embedding refresh (~1B docs/month).
- Latency SLOs: want P95 < 200ms for 32-token chat replies, P99 < 400ms; tail latency guarantees required for SLA.
- Availability: target 99.95% SLA for dedicated capacity with cross-region fallback.
- Security: VPC peering, SSO/SAML, encrypted at-rest with KMS, audit logs forwarded to SIEM, EU data residency for EU customers.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to commit to 12-18 month Reserved capacity if unit economics and fallback policy solid.

Dedicated capacity & GPU planning notes (from POC):
- POC run 2026-03-02: bench Llama2-70B-quant (q4_0 / q8_0) on A100-equivalent nodes. Observed sustained throughput ~240 token/s per GPU with continuous batching enabled; best-case 8 concurrent chats per GPU with KV cache hit-rate ~65%.
- Baseline sizing asks: reserve 16 GPUs for primary pool to hit target peak QPS with 95% utilization; plan 4-gpu warm standby for burst and failover. Customer wants throughput guarantees per SLA (min tokens/s per GPU) and documentation of degradation behavior.
- Want guidance on model-specific tuning: recommended context length cap at 16k for production with special 32k tier for premium customers (costed separately). Suggest quantization profile: q4_x4 for 70B to balance quality/throughput; evaluate int8 (q8_0) for lower-cost reranking batch jobs.
- Batching/KV cache policies: enable adaptive continuous batching for chat (latency-first policy at <=120ms targets) and large-batch mode for reranking; set KV cache TTL 24h for session reuse, and prefix caching for common system prompts.
